concepts.label: Configurable JavaScript Function (Sync Gateway)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - umbrella concept for the four database-configuration options that accept a JavaScript function body (Sync Function, Import Filter, Custom Conflict Resolver, Webhook Filter), each provisionable inline, from an external file, or from an external HTTP/HTTPS endpoint

concepts.label: Import Filter (Sync Gateway)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - genuine first contact; no import-filter concept exists in the registry at any layer prior to this batch. Fully detailed on configuration-schema-import-filter.md (same batch)

concepts.label: Custom Conflict Resolver (Sync Gateway)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the JavaScript function resolving replication conflicts, distinct from Server/XDCR's own conflict-resolution mechanisms (xdcr:conflict-resolution-method), which are non-programmable enum choices, not user-authored code

concepts.label: Webhook Filter (Sync Gateway)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the JavaScript function filtering which database change events fire a webhook

concepts.label: Inline JavaScript function (backtick-enclosed)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - one of three provisioning shapes for sgw:javascript-function

concepts.label: External JavaScript file
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - one of three provisioning shapes for sgw:javascript-function, specified by absolute path

concepts.label: External HTTP/HTTPS JavaScript endpoint
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - one of three provisioning shapes for sgw:javascript-function, requires a registered CA certificate when HTTPS-hosted

concepts.label: unsupported.remote_config_tls_skip_verify setting
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - test-only flag that bypasses TLS certificate verification specifically for external JavaScript loaded over HTTPS; distinct from bootstrap.server_tls_skip_verify (verifies the Sync Gateway <-> Couchbase Server connection, already minted in security/secure-sgw-access.json)

relations.subject: sgw:javascript-function
relations.evidence: An external HTTP/HTTPS endpoint serving a JS function

relations.subject: sgw:admin-rest-api
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused from access-control-concepts.json (round 3) - same predicate/pattern as sgw:admin-rest-api configuresProperty sgw:admin-channels-property, unpromoted
relations.evidence: Sync Gateway 3.x configuration of Javascript functions is done using the [Admin REST API](../rest-api/rest-api-admin.md); specifically the [Authentication](../rest-api/rest%5Fapi%5Fadmin.md#tag/Authentication) and [/{keyspace}/\_config/import\_filter](../rest-api/rest%5Fapi%5Fadmin.md#tag/Database-Configuration/operation/put%5Fkeyspace-%5Fconfig-import%5Ffilter) endpoints.

relations.subject: sgw:external-javascript-http-source
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (promoted requiresSetting) - inverse-flavoured: this setting is what an operator can use to bypass the normal CA-certificate requirement for this source type, for testing only
relations.evidence: For testing purposes you may use the unsupported configuration option `[unsupported.remote_config_tls_skip_verify](configuration-schema-database.md#database-unsupported-remote%5Fconfig%5Ftls%5Fskip%5Fverify     )`. Setting this `true` will side-step essential security checks. Do not use in Production deployments.

relations.subject: sgw:external-javascript-http-source
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (promoted requiresSetting) - reusing Couchbase Server's own cert:trust-store concept for the system certificate pool Sync Gateway itself must trust the external JS host against, since the page describes registering a CA certificate rather than a Sync Gateway-specific trust mechanism
relations.evidence: You must register a CA certificate for the appropriate server if external Javascript functions are hosted on HTTPS endpoints.

notable_absence.finding: None on this page - it is a short, complete conceptual + procedural page with a worked example rather than a schema/field enumeration.

cross_component_finding: This page is the first place in the batch establishing sgw:import-filter, sgw:custom-conflict-resolver and sgw:webhook-filter as siblings of the already-known sgw:sync-function under one umbrella (all four take a JavaScript function body and share the same three provisioning shapes and the same Admin REST API configuration pattern already seen for sgw:admin-channels-property). This is the clearest confirmation this round's framing question predicted: first contact with configuration/ mostly reuses vocabulary and patterns (configuresProperty via the Admin REST API, requiresSetting for TLS bypass) already established by access-control/ and security/, rather than inventing a wholly new mechanism shape.
cross_product_finding: sgw:custom-conflict-resolver is explicitly distinguished in its own concept note from xdcr:conflict-resolution-method: Sync Gateway's conflict resolution is user-authored JavaScript, selectable per-replication, while XDCR's is a fixed enum (Sequence Number or Timestamp) chosen at bucket creation. No relationship is stated between the two on this page or elsewhere in the batch so far; kept separate.
